rules.advisoryReason: NEW 2026-08-18. Spec 35 F.1: a composite's selectors.typography must target its own ROOT, never a child's dead BEM class. Guards the THIRD defect layer (declared / rendered / CONSUMED) that no other rule checks: a native typography control can exist, render, and save a value while its generated CSS never reaches the painted element. WORKED EXAMPLE: sgs/hero's 7 declared native typography controls are silent no-ops because selectors.typography targets .sgs-hero__headline, which edit.js sets only as an InnerBlocks TEMPLATE child's className — the generated scoped rule sits at (0,2,0) and cannot beat that child block's own inline typography at (1,0,0,0), this framework's HC2 rule. A NAIVE TEXT SEARCH CANNOT SEE THIS, proven live: it returned 2 false positives (sgs/modal, sgs/social-icons — the WP-core-generated wp-block-sgs-* root class, legitimately absent from source) and MISSED hero entirely, because .sgs-hero__headline IS present in hero's files, just never as a DOM class attribute.
